title: Calibration Protocol for Particle Standard Curve with Microspheres
author: Richard Tennant
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zgjf3un
materials: You have now completed this calibration protocol

steps.title: Maintain microsphere temperature
steps.instruction: Do not store microspheres at 0 °C or below; if you suspect freezing, email measurement@igem.org for a replacement.

steps.title: Prepare microsphere stock solution
steps.instruction: Obtain the 300 µL “Silica Beads” tube from the Measurement Kit, vortex vigorously for 30 seconds; pipet 100 µL of the beads into a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube, add 900 µL ddH₂O, vortex briefly to mix, creating the microsphere stock solution.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 100 µL beads to new tube

steps.title: Add ddH₂O to plate wells
steps.instruction: Dispense 100 µL ddH₂O into every well of rows A, B, C, and D in columns 2 through 12 (A2‑D12). Column 12 will contain only ddH₂O.

steps.title: Vortex stock before plate loading
steps.instruction: Vortex the microsphere stock tube vigorously for 10 seconds.

steps.title: Load stock into first well
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of the microsphere stock solution to well A1.

steps.title: Perform serial dilutions in row A
steps.instruction: Transfer 100 µL from the preceding well to the next column, mixing by pipetting up and down three times after each transfer, proceeding from A1 → A2 through A10 → A11; discard the final 100 µL into liquid waste and do not continue into column 12.

steps.title: Repeat dilutions for rows B‑D
steps.instruction: Repeat the serial‑dilution procedure described for row A in rows B, C, and D, using the same 100 µL transfers, 3× mixing, and discarding the final 100 µL from column 11.

steps.title: Re‑mix plate before reading
steps.instruction: Immediately before placing the plate in the reader, pipette up and down gently in every well of rows A‑D to resuspend beads, avoiding bubbles (beads settle within ~10 minutes).

steps.title: Measure optical density
steps.instruction: Measure OD₆₀₀ of all wells using the plate reader.

steps.title: Record and analyze data
steps.instruction: Record the OD₆₀₀ values in your notebook and import them into the iGEM Data Analysis Template – Particle Standard Curve – v1.xlsx.
